rows.title: One card, fixed anatomy
rows.defect: the load-bearing field check is skipped
rows.test: a card missing any load-bearing field is refused

rows.title: Time-bounded
rows.defect: expired cards are never swept, so a late yes fires
rows.test: a yes after 10 minutes is refused

rows.title: Single-use
rows.test: a card fires once and is marked consumed

rows.title: Context-bound
rows.defect: an older card is left live when a new one is issued, so a yes binds to the older one
rows.test: a new card supersedes the live one

rows.title: Read-back in the user's terms
rows.test: a text without the amount, total and counterparty does not read back

rows.title: Plain-text degradation
rows.defect: every channel gets the button wording, so SMS has no way to confirm
rows.test: SMS gets a reply instruction it can complete in plain text

rows.title: The reply is understood per channel
rows.defect: the numeric reply is not understood as yes

rows.title: "Never mind" stops everything
rows.defect: never mind replies but leaves the card live
rows.test: after never mind a yes fires nothing

rows.title: A correction mid-card makes exactly one new card
rows.defect: a correction leaves the old card live
rows.test: the old card is dead before the new one exists

rows.title: A new request mid-card is not stacked
rows.defect: a new request silently leaves the card pending
rows.test: the card is dropped and the user is told

rows.title: Undo terms before firing
rows.defect: the undo statement is not validated
rows.test: a vague undo statement is refused

rows.title: The receipt restates the undo window and honors it
rows.defect: the undo window is not enforced
rows.test: undo after the window is refused honestly

rows.title: A card follows the user across channels
rows.defect: the store looks the live card up by channel, so a reply from another channel finds nothing
rows.test: a card issued on SMS is confirmed in-app

rows.title: Duplicate delivery fires once
rows.defect: a yes with no live card re-fires the last consumed card
rows.test: two yes replies consume the card once

rows.title: The transcript tells the truth
rows.test: a yes that did not fire has its reason in the log

rows.title: Two SMS segments at most
rows.defect: the two-segment cap is not enforced
rows.test: a card that would need a third segment is never shown
